notes: Template for a dev-split ABox revision (14 queries, everything determinate, no worlds). The new capital lies in another country, so the edit reaches stored facts through the inverse capital_of: its subproperty (related near), transitivity through a landmark (related far), its role chain into a region (derived, hemisphere), inheritance of a country-wide rule used in a practical task (which side to overtake on, from the driving side) and binding through a description of New Zealand. Following README (subproperty, the Lyon example), Barcelona is then in New Zealand: a model that keeps it in Spain has a capital outside its country. Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama) except those marked approximate.
